controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T18:35:57.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:35:57.000Z"
        AND (destination.ip == "172.18.0.12" OR destination.ip == "172.18.0.17" OR destination.ip == "127.0.0.1")
        AND destination.port == 22
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        earliest = MIN(@timestamp),
        latest = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port
| SORT total DESC
| LIMIT 20
